description: This file defines the class 'nusoap_xmlschema' which provides methods to parse, interpret, and serialize XML Schemas (XSD). It allows handling complex and simple types, elements, attributes, and imports within a schema, facilitating schema validation and code generation tasks in a SOAP/WSDL context.

classes.name: nusoap_xmlschema
classes.description: Class for parsing, managing, and serializing XML Schema definitions, supporting complex and simple types, elements, attributes, and namespace handling for SOAP/WSDL applications.

methods.name: addComplexType
methods.description: Adds a complex type definition to the schema, supporting various configurations including elements, attributes, and restrictions.

methods.name: addSimpleType
methods.description: Adds a simple type to the schema with optional enumerations and restrictions.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds an element, with comprehensive attributes, to the schema.

methods.name: serializeSchema
methods.description: Serializes the entire schema to an XML string, including types, elements, attributes, and namespace declarations.

methods.name: getTypeDef
methods.description: Returns detailed information (definition array) about a specified type, element, or attribute.

methods.name: getPHPType
methods.description: Retrieves the PHP type mapping for a given type and namespace.

methods.name: createTypeName
methods.description: Generates a unique name for unnamed complex types based on scope.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML Schema or XML file from a provided URI.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses an XML string (Schema or XML data) and builds internal data structures.
